## 💡 Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature or enhancement you are proposing.

## 🎯 Motivation & Problem Statement
Why is this feature needed? What user problem or learning scenario does it address?

## 🚀 Proposed Solution
Describe the solution or visual interaction you would like to see.

## ♿ Accessibility Considerations
How does this feature maintain non-auditory visual feedback and WCAG compliance?
